title: Next week: options and decisions
text:
Next week: options and decisions (week of Oct. 26, 2026)
As of Friday, Oct. 23, 2026, 5:06 p.m. CT. Prepared by Morgan.

Lance's calls (in the approval queue; Patricia presents them at 7 a.m.)
1. Background checks for Taylor's hiring section.
Two questions: which vendor to use, and whether to keep the Nurse Aide Registry check.
The brief recommends KDADS as the vendor, after an OIG exclusion search and a sex offender registry search, and keeping the Nurse Aide Registry check. Morgan's lean: take both of the brief's picks.
This unblocks the hiring section.
Tell Morgan your pick.

2. Taylor's shared to-do list.
Options: (a) one shared list Taylor can see, or (b) items stay inside the binder emails only.
Morgan's lean: (a), so we can review it at the Wednesday, Oct. 28, meeting.
Tell Morgan your pick.

3. Branding.
Options: the three options Digital Production sent to Lance's chat tonight, each with a short guide, cleared by Editor at 5:03 p.m.
Digital Production's lean: Option B. The paid image tool plan only matters if Lance picks C. After the pick, choose a logo designer.
Tell Morgan your pick.

4. Golden Rule retainer.
Confirm the first full $200 covers November and is due Dec. 20.
Morgan's lean: yes.
Tell Morgan your pick.

5. Morgan's five paused routines: the morning firm brief, the usage forecast, the Weekly Sync cue, the monthly LPD essay cue, and the Friday requisition review.
Options: resume the morning firm brief and the usage forecast only, or keep all five paused.
Morgan's lean: resume those two.
Tell Morgan your pick.

Routine calls Morgan makes (shown here, no action needed)
- Binder: Writer and Editor finish the cover email and the revised copies. Lance approves in order and sends them himself. Next to draft: governing body, administration, contracts, the employee handbook, and the assessment form.
- Taylor meeting: Wednesday, Oct. 28, 11:30 a.m. to 12:30 p.m. CT. Morgan preps the agenda from the open items by Tuesday.
- Grants: the KDHE grant research (due Nov. 18, noon CT) is ready to walk through whenever Lance asks. No drafting until he says go.
- Accounts Receivable: the next due-date check is Nov. 13. Nothing is due this week.
- Coder: the Command Deck gets data updates only, with no new builds without Lance's approval.
- Ops Planner, Market Scout, Onboarder: stay on hold. Onboarder resumes grading and orients Accounts Receivable once Taylor's package ships.
- Usage: the Oct. 20 binder-only order stays in effect, apart from work Lance directs.
